title: Circle Medical (YC S15) Is Hiring a Mobile Engineer
summary: Circle Medical, a Y Combinator-backed healthcare startup (S15 batch), is hiring a Mobile Engineer specializing in Android development to build their mobile health application.
problem_solved: This is a job posting rather than a technical article, so it does not solve a technical problem - it represents a career opportunity in mobile healthcare development.
why_valuable: Provides insight into the technical stack and requirements for Android engineers at a YC-backed digital health company.
